# netbox_tagged_objects (Data Source)

Retrieves all tagged objects from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_tagged_objects" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "id"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "tagged_objects_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_tagged_objects.example.tagged_objects[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tagged_objects` (Attributes List) The tagged objects found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tagged_objects))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--tagged_objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tagged_objects`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The id of the tagged objects.
- `object` (String) The object of the tagged objects.
- `object_id` (Number) The object id of the tagged objects.
- `object_type` (String) The object type of the tagged objects.
- `tag_id` (Number) The ID of the tag associated with the tagged objects.
